name: GX600
summary: Light carbon flat-bar all-road bike with a 9.1 kg small-size complete claim, but its published 35C stock tire does not establish the maximum clearance.

frame.construction: Internally routed thru-axle carbon all-road frame; exact lay-up schedule and molding process are not published
frame.stiffness_evidence: No meaningful independent exact-PES stiffness or deflection evidence was found; qualitative reports for custom or Shimano GX600 builds are not transferred to this PES configuration
frame.claimed_fiber: T800 frame; T700 fork and seatpost (official material claim)

tire_clearance.note: Do not include in a >38 mm shortlist until the seller confirms the exact maximum and clearance.
